provenance: The Q5 avoidance direction was generated after observing the frozen V1.1 adverse recovery surface and the subsequent Q1-Q5 decomposition. This experiment can freeze a future negative-selection hypothesis but cannot confirm Alpha.

sample.sample_type: SHOCK only; frozen GENERIC_W2/W3/W5 matched non-shock rows are reused only for the generic comparison
sample.selected_bucket_meaning: strongest Recovery Fraction quintile within the exact frozen V1.1 cell/date cross-section

q5_metrics: severe_loss_incidence at h20 only using MAE <= -10%; null at shorter horizons
mean MAE at h20 only; null at shorter horizons

baseline_decomposition.event_sample: all complete Q1-Q5 shock events in the same frozen cell/horizon
baseline_decomposition.q5_minus_event_absolute: Q5 absolute mean minus event-sample absolute mean
baseline_decomposition.q5_minus_event_industry_relative: Q5 industry-relative mean minus event-sample industry-relative mean
baseline_decomposition.q5_weakness_share: negative Q5-minus-event absolute contribution divided by the positive Q1-Q5 absolute spread when that spread is positive
baseline_decomposition.aggregation: equal-weight across the 18 cells; nested cell counts cannot select the family conclusion

family_counts.q5_below_event_cell: Q5-minus-event mean < 0 in the named coordinate

chronology.block_metrics: Q5 metrics and negative-cell counts for 2018-2021 and 2022-2023
chronology.year_metrics: Q5 metrics and negative-cell counts for each 2018 through 2023 calendar year
chronology.stable_block_direction: equal-cell Q5 absolute and industry-relative means are both < 0 in both blocks at h5/h10/h20
chronology.stable_year_breadth: at each h5/h10/h20 at least four of six years have equal-cell Q5 absolute and industry-relative means both < 0

controls.shock_severity: reuse the V1.1 absolute bins [threshold,8%), [8%,10%), [10%,infinity) crossed with relative bins [threshold,6%), [6%,8%), [8%,infinity)
controls.pre_shock_trend: reuse causal prior-20 log-return within-date terciles
controls.realized_volatility: reuse causal prior-20 sample-volatility within-date terciles
controls.adverse_supported_group: at least 100 Q5 observations and Q5 absolute and industry-relative means are both < 0 at h5/h10/h20
controls.control_survival: at least half of supported severity groups and at least two of three trend, volatility, and liquidity terciles are adverse supported groups

generic_recovery.samples: frozen ABS_m06_REL_m04_W2/W3/W5 shocks versus the already matched GENERIC_W2/W3/W5 non-shocks
generic_recovery.metrics: Q5 absolute/industry-relative means and Q5-minus-event means at h5/h10/h20
generic_recovery.comparable_generic_window: generic Q5-minus-event absolute mean is negative at h5/h10/h20, its mean primary-horizon absolute magnitude is at least 75% of the paired shock magnitude, and generic Q5-minus-event industry-relative mean is negative at h5/h10/h20
generic_recovery.generic_recovery_chasing_risk: at least two of three windows are comparable generic windows

risk_anatomy.broad_q5_weakness: at every primary horizon at least 12/18 cells have a negative Q5 absolute median and at least 12/18 have positive-return rate below 50%
risk_anatomy.tail_comparison: at h20 compare Q5 severe-loss incidence and mean MAE with the full event sample in each cell
risk_anatomy.mean_only: Q5 mean weakness passes but broad Q5 weakness fails at at least two primary horizons

classification_gates.chronologically_unstable: Q5 absolute or industry-relative equal-cell mean changes sign between early and late in at least two of h5/h10/h20
classification_gates.mean_weakness: at every h5/h10/h20 at least 12/18 cells have negative Q5 absolute mean, negative Q5 industry-relative mean, both means negative, and Q5-minus-event means negative in both coordinates
classification_gates.material_event_underperformance: Q5-minus-event means are negative in both coordinates at h5/h10/h20 and the equal-weight average absolute Q5-minus-event mean over h5/h10/h20 is <= -0.20%
classification_gates.post_hoc_strong_recovery_avoidance_candi: mean weakness, material event underperformance, broad Q5 weakness, stable block direction, stable year breadth, and control survival all pass, while generic recovery chasing risk does not
classification_gates.relative_avoidance_only: at every h5/h10/h20 at least 12/18 cells have negative Q5 industry-relative mean and Q5-minus-event industry-relative mean, both development blocks are negative industry-relative at all primary horizons, and the absolute mean-weakness gate fails
classification_gates.mean_only_q5_weakness: mean weakness and material event underperformance pass but broad Q5 weakness fails at at least two primary horizons
classification_gates.no_actionable_avoidance_information: none of the preceding categories applies

strategy_a_independence.analysis: reuse V1.1 and prior anatomy overlap/correlation/exclusion evidence only

prohibited: Q4 plus Q5, top percentiles, continuous cutoff, or alternative avoidance score
new shock, recovery, control, or parameter definitions
threshold, horizon, bucket, execution, or portfolio optimization
